clauses.name: Solenero, the Contrite
clauses.printedParagraph: If Solenero loses the confrontation, you can return a target card from your Limbo to your hand.
clauses.expectedBehavior: The printed effect accepts only the declared public-zone card or the controller's own Hand card, with exact cardinality, type, owner, container and temporal constraints. Missing, private, stale, duplicate or otherwise invalid targets are rejected without mutation. A valid target begins the printed card-specific result and its first authoritative state change.
